line: Developing a general-purpose robot manipulation policy for dishwasher tasks. Advisor: Prof. Ahmed H. Qureshi.

org: HawAII, University of Hawaiʻi at Mānoa
line: Co-developed Fiatlux, an Isaac Lab benchmark in which a Unitree G1 humanoid climbs a ladder to replace a bulb. For the AI for Industry Challenge, upgraded a privileged expert for UR5e cable insertion and trained ACT and Diffusion Policy policies from expert demos. Advisor: Prof. Igor Molybog.

Built a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) pipeline from scratch for text-to-SQL tasks with self-consistency decoding; cut inference costs by moving from a closed- to an open-source model while preserving 80% accuracy.
Applied formal methods to verify functional correctness in a project inspired by seL4 and RT-11, with a proof strategy in interactive theorem proving (Isabelle/HOL).
Devised an efficient algorithm to simulate a mathematical model of biological reactions, and created 2D and 3D models to visualize its results.
